purpose: Seed signal register for pressure tracking, buyer linkage, initiative linkage, and action handoff.

schema_notes.buyers: Mapped buyer IDs impacted by the signal.
schema_notes.initiatives: Mapped initiative IDs impacted by the signal.
schema_notes.constraints: Mapped constraint IDs directly pressured by the signal where known.
schema_notes.decision_owners: Named internal or external decision owners to secure.
schema_notes.action_hook: Immediate action the operating system should take next.
schema_notes.evidence_refs: Existing files or artifacts supporting the signal.
schema_notes.source_registers: Current source systems used to derive the seed entry.

entries.signal_key: nigeria net fx reserves rise 772% to $34.8b; gross reserves reach $50.45b in feb 2026
entries.action_hook: Refresh the Nigeria spine mandate-path memo around improved reserves as timing support, while still framing transparency and execution-governance as the gating blocker.
entries.why_it_matters: Improved reserve posture can strengthen sovereign and DFI confidence, but does not remove underlying structure/governance friction.

entries.signal_key: dangote refinery begins international export tenders
entries.action_hook: Convert this into a corridor-platform memo update focused on supply-anchor realism, allocation timing, and family-capital mandate readiness.
entries.why_it_matters: This is a real-world supply-anchor movement that can convert corridor theory into a timed platform thesis.

entries.signal_key: uganda rail financing pivots toward u.s./western arrangers after china-backed pathway stalls
entries.action_hook: Use as contextual framing for the Uganda data-centers discussion: western arranger appetite may exist where stalled strategic infrastructure needs new structuring pathways.
entries.why_it_matters: Even though it is rail, it sharpens the live thesis that Uganda infrastructure lanes may now be more open to alternative structuring and financing sponsors.

entries.signal_key: world bank group approves ~$1.1b angola package with miga-backed debt refinance structure
entries.action_hook: Update Angola corridor positioning around refinance-ready sovereign credibility and institutional co-finance pathways rather than pure greenfield speculation.
entries.why_it_matters: Signals that Angola remains institutionally financeable when structures are de-risked, which supports a pre-FID corridor narrative.

entries.signal_key: us virgin islands $18b–$25b disaster recovery infrastructure program
entries.action_hook: Build a focused deployment-constraint brief linking workforce housing, accountable office, and capital stack clarity into one board-ready conversion memo.
entries.why_it_matters: This is a live capital-deployment system with scale, but the bottleneck is governance and workforce architecture rather than opportunity volume.

entries.signal_key: afc launches africa we build summit 2026 to mobilise domestic capital for industrial transformation
entries.action_hook: Prepare an AFC-facing angle that positions USG as commitment-architecture layer for domestic-capital mobilization rather than generic project advisory.
entries.why_it_matters: AFC is explicitly pushing capital mobilization architecture, which is structurally aligned with governance-compression positioning.
